chalisa.do1: Victory to Brahmā, victory to the Self-born, the four-faced one, root of happiness. Show grace to your own servant and remain ever favourable.
chalisa.do2: You are the creator of the universe; Aja, Vidhi and Dhātā are your names. Creator of the world, show your lovely grace to your devotee.
chalisa.cau1: Victory, victory to the lotus-seated one, root of the world. Remain ever favourable to your devotees. ॥1॥
chalisa.cau2: Your four-armed form is supremely lovely; you have faces turned to all four directions. ॥2॥
chalisa.cau3: Your handsome body is red in colour; on your head is an imposing mass of matted locks. ॥3॥
chalisa.cau4: Above it shines a crown; your white beard shines with great splendour. ॥4॥
chalisa.cau5: Wearing white garments you look handsome; your sacred thread is most charming. ॥5॥
chalisa.cau6: Lovely earrings shine in your ears; a garland of pearls graces your neck. ॥6॥
chalisa.cau7: It was you who revealed all four Vedas and taught divine knowledge to the three worlds. ॥7॥
chalisa.cau8: Brahmaloka is your auspicious abode; your fame has spread through all the worlds. ॥8॥
chalisa.cau9: Your consort is Sāvitrī, whose other name, dwelling in the heart, is Gāyatrī. ॥9॥
chalisa.cau10: Lovely Sarasvatī is your daughter, player of the vīṇā, beautiful in every way. ॥10॥
chalisa.cau11: You remain seated on your lotus seat; you have arrayed every adornment of devotion to Hari. ॥11॥
chalisa.cau12: The lord of the gods, Viṣṇu, lay asleep on the ocean of milk; from his navel an incomparable lotus appeared. ॥12॥
chalisa.cau13: On it you are seated, merciful one, and ever protect the saints. ॥13॥
chalisa.cau14: A story is told of one time: a great delusion came over your mind. ॥14॥
chalisa.cau15: Looking at your lotus seat, you reflected that there was no one else in the world. ॥15॥
chalisa.cau16: Then you took hold of the lotus stalk and vowed to see its end. ॥16॥
chalisa.cau17: Millions of years passed in this way; wandering on and on, days and nights went by. ॥17॥
chalisa.cau18: But you did not find its end; you lost hope and grew exceedingly sad. ॥18॥
chalisa.cau19: Then you thought this in your mind: this great lotus is very ancient. ॥19॥
chalisa.cau20: Why did it come into being? For this reason alone: that it bears me. ॥20॥
chalisa.cau21: In all the worlds there is no one anywhere; everything is contained within me. ॥21॥
chalisa.cau22: Resolving this, you swelled with pride and, taking yourself to be Brahman, were content. ॥22॥
chalisa.cau23: Then a deep voice came from the sky: Brahmā, hold steady and listen to my words. ॥23॥
chalisa.cau24: He who is the master of all creation is Brahman, beginningless and unseen. ॥24॥
chalisa.cau25: By his own will he created all; he made Brahmā, Viṣṇu and Maheśa. ॥25॥
chalisa.cau26: The three gods appeared for the sake of creation; the whole world will serve them. ॥26॥
chalisa.cau27: The great lotus that is your seat is under Viṣṇu's rule. ॥27॥
chalisa.cau28: It came forth from Viṣṇu's navel. I have made the truth plain to you. ॥28॥
chalisa.cau29: Go and meet Viṣṇu, regarding him as your well-wisher. Saying this, the voice from the sky fell silent. ॥29॥
chalisa.cau30: Hearing what was said, Brahmā was amazed; then the four-faced one set out. ॥30॥
chalisa.cau31: Holding the lotus stalk, he came down, and there he beheld Viṣṇu. ॥31॥
chalisa.cau32: He saw the lord of the gods lying asleep, his dark-hued body supremely incomparable. ॥32॥
chalisa.cau33: His four arms are very beautiful; a diadem-crown shines on his head. ॥33॥
chalisa.cau34: The vaijayantī garland graces his neck, putting to shame the splendour of ten million suns. ॥34॥
chalisa.cau35: Conch, discus and lovely mace, with the lotus: all his weapons are beautiful. ॥35॥
chalisa.cau36: Ramā ceaselessly presses his feet; his bed, the serpent Śeṣa, is most charming. ॥36॥
chalisa.cau37: Seeing that divine form, Brahmā bowed; the lord of Śrī, abode of happiness, was delighted. ॥37॥
chalisa.cau38: The four-faced one prayed humbly in many ways; then Lakṣmī's lord said, glad at heart: ॥38॥
chalisa.cau39: Brahmā, cast off your pride. We two are forms of Brahman, and equal. ॥39॥
chalisa.cau40: The third is Śrī Śiva. In the three worlds, all are forms of Brahman. ॥40॥
chalisa.cau41: Through you creation spreads; I shall sustain the world. ॥41॥
chalisa.cau42: Śiva brings about the destruction of all. We three have much work. ॥42॥
chalisa.cau43: Describe the blessed Brahman as without attributes; know him to be formless. ॥43॥
chalisa.cau44: We three gods are forms with shape; we shall always serve Brahman. ॥44॥
chalisa.cau45: Hearing this, Brahmā was supremely glad and sang at length the glory of the Supreme Brahman. ॥45॥
chalisa.cau46: All that is known by the name of the Veda; it is liberation itself, supremely lovely. ॥46॥
chalisa.cau47: In this way, Lord, your birth came about; then you brought the world forth. ॥47॥
chalisa.cau48: You received the lovely name Pitāmaha and created all things, inert and conscious. ॥48॥
chalisa.cau49: You took incarnation many times and spread your fair glory through the world. ॥49॥
chalisa.cau50: Gods and demons all meditate on you; all obtain from you what their hearts desire. ॥50॥
chalisa.cau51: Whoever meditates on you, man or woman, you fulfil all their hopes. ॥51॥
chalisa.cau52: The holy place of Puṣkara gives supreme happiness; there you ever dwell, king of the gods. ॥52॥
chalisa.cau53: Whoever bathes in its pool and worships, all his faults are removed. ॥53॥
